definitions.latency: httpx client round trip ms, not browser or server-only time
definitions.hit_rate: initial hits/(initial hits+misses); exclude bypass, inspection, invalidation and unknown
definitions.sql: returned actual attempts incl ownership; product count separately
definitions.ttl: sampled PTTL ms; -2 absent, -1 unbounded, null unavailable
definitions.memory: selected Redis value key MEMORY USAGE estimate bytes
definitions.sources: local launch sources; server revision not independently attested

limitations: Short functional sample, not capacity or reliable tail latency evidence
Full traces/inspection add overhead; monitor counters include other activity
Absent key after waiting is an observation, not a keyspace expiry event
Only received traces counted; unavailable responses have unknown SQL
